notes.title: Horns of Justice beta available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are excited to bring you the [b]Horns of Justice beta version[/b]. This version adds the final story chapters, a new playable character and many smaller improvements!

Bear in mind that this beta version is still in a prototype stage, much is not yet representative of the final product. 

Nevertheless we are curious to hear what you think! Now is the time to help us build the best game possible. Let us know your comments or feedback on our Discord.

If you haven't signed up to the beta yet, click the green "Request access" button on the store page.

We hope to see you on the sands of the arena!

[b]Horns of Justice beta (v0.8.0)[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Final chapters for the singleplayer mode[/b]: Reach the conclusion of the tournament. Will your actions be able to shape the future of Etanor?

[*] [b]A new playable character: [i]"Terrack, the artillerist"[/i][/b]: Play as everyone's favorite champion of Etanor in this patch. Use your artillery shells to rain death on your opponents from afar.

[*] [b]Improved sound effects, music and additional voice-overs.[/b]

[*] [b]Many, many small tweaks, improvements and bugfixes.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest finished!
notes.content:
The Steam Next Fest has ended. Thank you all for playing the demo and giving us your feedback!

This feedback is very valuable for us to keep on improving the game. We hope to release an updated version soon that will address some of the improvements you have suggested.

If you didn't get a chance to play, or want to continue playing, you can sign up for alpha testing using the green "Request access" button on the Steam store page. 

Follow our social media channels to not miss out on anything!
Discord: https://discord.gg/ftuvQu3ZRC
reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/HornsOfJustice/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HornsGame

notes.title: Horns of Justice demo now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're happy to let you know that a public demo of Horns of Justice is now available on Steam, to celebrate our participation in the Steam Next Fest.

This demo will remain available for at least until the end of the festival (on June 22nd). Let us know what you think of the demo on our Discord or reddit communities. 

See you on the sands of the arena!


Follow our social media channels to not miss out on anything!

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Launched!
notes.content:
This is the pre-alpha release of Horns of Justice. The game isn't finished yet but we would like to test the waters with you. Visit our store page and click 'Request Access' to join in, have fun and let us know how we are doing. We appreciate your help in making Horns of Justice reach its full potential.
